Case note: C.P.(IB) No. 574/2025
Client: Sunanda DSouza (orthopaedic surgeon, Mysuru)
Opposing party: M/s Aravali Holdings Ltd
Court: NCLT Mumbai
Filed on: 25 September 2025
Claim amount: Rs 32,07,00,000
Issue: cross-border insolvency. The debtor is in insolvency proceedings in two countries.
Advice given: File the claim with the resolution professional before the deadline.
Outcome: The claim was admitted in full.
Recommended next step: Vote on the resolution plan.
